# noozle_http_server_outlet (Resource)

Manages a Noozle HTTP Server outlet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "noozle_http_server_outlet" "alerts" {
  name          = "HTTP Server alerts"
  enabled       = true
  path          = "/api/outlets/alerts"
  notify_policy = "FIRST_ONLY"

  transform {
    selected = "summarize"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the outlet is active.
- `name` (String) Name presented for the outlet.
- `path` (String) HTTP server path.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `address` (String) Custom HTTP server bind address.
- `allowed_verbs` (List of String) HTTP verbs allowed for path and stream path endpoints.
- `cors_allowed_headers` (List of String) Additional CORS headers to allow.
- `cors_allowed_methods` (List of String) CORS methods to allow.
- `cors_allowed_origins` (List of String) CORS origins to allow.
- `cors_enabled` (Boolean) Enable CORS handling for a custom HTTP server address.
- `description` (String) Optional note explaining the outlet purpose.
- `heartbeat` (String) HTTP stream heartbeat interval.
- `notify_policy` (String) Delivery policy applied when notifying this outlet.
- `ping_period` (String) Websocket ping period.
- `pong_wait` (String) Websocket pong wait timeout.
- `stream_format` (String) HTTP stream endpoint format.
- `stream_path` (String) HTTP server stream path.
- `timeout` (String) HTTP path endpoint timeout.
- `tls` (Block, Optional) Optional inline TLS feature for the HTTP server outlet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tls))
- `transform` (Attributes) Optional outlet transform selection and observed runtime state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transform))
- `write_wait` (String) Websocket write timeout.
- `ws_message_type` (String) Websocket message type.
- `ws_path` (String) HTTP server websocket path.

### Read-Only

- `applied_generation` (Number) Last observed applied config generation.
- `apply_status` (String) Observed apply/runtime status for the outlet.
- `config_generation` (Number) Desired outlet config generation.
- `id` (Number) Unique identifier of the outlet.
- `last_apply_error` (String) Last observed apply/runtime error message.
